description: Header file defining the EquationCollection class, which manages a collection of Equation objects with observable vector capabilities and event handling for property changes.

classes.name: EquationCollection
classes.description: A sealed class implementing an observable collection of Equation objects with event handling for property changes.

methods.name: First
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the first element in the collection.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Adds a new Equation to the collection and subscribes to its PropertyChanged event.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears the collection and unsubscribes from all Equation PropertyChanged events.

methods.name: GetAt
methods.description: Retrieves the Equation at the specified index.

methods.name: GetMany
methods.description: Retrieves multiple Equation objects starting from a specified index.

methods.name: GetView
methods.description: Returns a read-only view of the collection.

methods.name: IndexOf
methods.description: Finds the index of a specified Equation.

methods.name: InsertAt
methods.description: Inserts an Equation at a specified index and subscribes to its PropertyChanged event.

methods.name: RemoveAt
methods.description: Removes the Equation at a specified index and unsubscribes from its PropertyChanged event.

methods.name: RemoveAtEnd
methods.description: Removes the last Equation in the collection.

methods.name: ReplaceAll
methods.description: Replaces the entire collection with a new array of Equations and manages event subscriptions.

methods.name: SetAt
methods.description: Replaces the Equation at a specific index and updates event subscriptions.
